title: AG60109: Soil Dynamics In Tillage And Traction
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Measurement of dynamic properties of soil in compression, tension, shear,
impact, friction and adhesion. Soil strength. Mechanics of rigid, rotary and
oscillating tillage tools. Design and performance of various tillage tools.
Tyre size, load and pressure relationship. Mechanics and design of traction and
transport devices. Theories for predicting thrust and rolling resistance.
Measurement and characterization of terrain response. Methods for parametric
analysis of wheeled vehicle performance. Analysis of tracked vehicle
performance. Traction improvement. Handling characteristics of off-road
vehicle.
